correctness.rationale: The exact semicircle-anchoring identity P(p outside hull)=n∫ f(s)Q_p(s)^{n-1} ds counts the unique anchor for continuously sampled cyclic directions. For boundary local arclength s>0, the opposite-ray chord endpoint is tδ(s)=−2δ/(κ(z)s)+O(δ+δ²/s²); its arc mass changes by −2f(z)δ/(κ(z)s). Expanding (n−1)th power over Cδ≤s≤η yields coefficient 2n(n−1)f(z)^2/κ(z) times δlog(1/δ). Other parts, including the returning endpoint near the opposite side of z, are O(δ) for n>=3. The circle n=3 dilogarithm formula independently yields the same log coefficient, though convergence of numerical ratios is slow at moderate δ. The n-fixed scope and uniform Oδ error are correctly stated.
